name: org-credential-store-user

graded_by.test: owed: U2's handler tests in core/ (against C7, over a fake vault); E4 phase 6 (U2: auth, locks and the vault and device HTTP handlers over a fake vault); the test is named in phase 16
owed: U6's tests in vault/; E4 phases 7-9 (U6: vault core, device trust, org tier and grants); the test is named in phase 16

description: Store an org credential, a vault administrator only (403 forbidden otherwise), with its unlock class chosen explicitly and never inferred; the cred.store line carries the class. It is sealed under the storing administrator's encryption_key, so it needs this login's unlock (409 vault_locked otherwise) and stops for every grantee when that administrator's vault locks (credential-protection §8.2).
